We are currently seeking a highly skilled Quality Engineering Officer to join our team and drive technical optimization across our manufacturing operations.  The Quality Engineering Officer will play a critical role in optimizing our packaging production lines and manufacturing technologies. You will be responsible for analysing system performance, implementing process improvements, and ensuring that our manufacturing workflows operate at peak efficiency, quality, and compliance. This role bridges the gap between production and engineering, requiring a hands-on approach to technical troubleshooting, equipment validation, and data-driven continuous improvement.   Benefits   Task & responsibilities   Evaluate manufacturing lines and equipment performance to pinpoint opportunities for increasing productivity, efficiency, and product quality.  Conduct root cause analysis on equipment failures and process anomalies, implementing engineering-based solutions to restore and enhance operational reliability.  Formulate and execute process improvement strategies aimed at maximizing resource utilization and reducing operational waste.  Assess production methods against established technical specifications and engineering standards to ensure all manufacturing processes remain within defined parameters.  Provide hands-on technical guidance and troubleshooting for production machinery and process technologies to mitigate downtime and boost system output.  Design, refine, and enforce technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and process controls to maintain consistency in production outcomes.  Partner with production, quality, and engineering teams to streamline packaging systems and refine manufacturing workflows.  Participate in the commissioning, testing, and validation of new manufacturing assets to ensure they meet performance and engineering benchmarks.  Develop and oversee testing and inspection protocols to verify process capability and maintain rigorous product performance standards.  Analyse production metrics and performance data to identify operational trends, supporting the implementation of continuous improvement projects.  Assist in the maintenance of operational and quality management frameworks to ensure alignment with industry regulations and internal business requirements.  Track the success of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), evaluating the impact of implemented solutions and recommending further technical upgrades where needed.    Qualification & experience   A tertiary qualification (Bachelor’s degree or Higher) in Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related technical discipline.  Proven professional experience in a manufacturing, packaging, or industrial processing environment.  At least 3 years of professional experience in a similar role.  Solid understanding of engineering principles, production workflows, and manufacturing process controls.  Proficiency in utilising ERP systems (e.g., SAP or Microsoft Dynamics 365) for production data analysis and operational monitoring.  Demonstrated ability to conduct root cause analysis, troubleshoot equipment issues, and implement effective engineering solutions.  Excellent communication skills, with the ability to provide technical guidance and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.   About Company    A & M Packaging Pty Limited is a leading Australian manufacturer and supplier of flexible packaging solutions, specializing in high-performance lamination, conversion, and distribution services across the country. We partner with a diverse range of industries to deliver consistently high standards of manufacturing quality, technical precision, and operational efficiency.  With a strong commitment to engineering excellence and service, we provide tailored packaging solutions designed to meet the complex technical requirements of each client. Our business places significant emphasis on process innovation, workplace safety, and continuous improvement to ensure our production systems are highly efficient, reliable, and performance-driven.  At A & M Packaging, our team members are dedicated professionals who take pride in their technical expertise and contribute directly to the innovation and operational success of our manufacturing operations.
